class.description: DOD NOTE: ControlActionRebindMatrix provides a modular, interactive action-rebinding and Custom USB / Arduino ADC channel calibration matrix for `GameplayControlMap`. It supports: 1. Semantic Action Rebinding: Displays all 15 standard semantic actions (`move_forward`, `primary_action`, `interact`, `jump`, etc.) plus custom entries in `action_remap_table` and `action_to_agent_action_map`, with a one-click "Listen for Input..." capture mode that intercepts Keyboard keys, Mouse buttons, Joypad buttons/axes, or Custom USB channels. 2. binding Conflict Detection: Highlights duplicate input bindings across actions. 3. Custom USB / Arduino Serial & HID Channel Monitor & Calibrator: Subscribes to `custom_packet_received` on `GameplayControlMap`, displaying live normalized channel strengths (`AX`, `AY`, `LX`, `LY`, `BTN1`..`BTN4`) and one-click Min/Center/Max ADC calibration (`custom_channel_calibration`). Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
